answer: A newcomer files a jade patent with the canyon panel: a patent application, its filing number and inventor signature checked against the echo registry within thirty minutes of the nonce. The canyon panel matches the patent, the filing number, and the signature. A patent reused under a second name fails, and the inventor is barred for a cycle, forfeiting forty-four units. An honest inventor pays forty-four units once; a thousand fakes pay forty-four thousand units. A farm reusing one patent for a thousand clones fails: one patent binds one inventor to one jade.
